brief.md.content:
# Brief — Feature Flag & Canary Rollout Controller

## Problem
Percentage rollouts that call `Math.random()` reshuffle users on every request, and canaries that only page a human still ship a bad build to the rest of the cohort.

## Target users
Backend and frontend owners running a progressive rollout.

## Core behavior
- Bucket `fnv1a(flag + ':' + subject) % 100`. A subject is enrolled when `bucket < percentage`.
- Record canary outcomes. When samples reach `minSamples` and `errors / samples >= errorThreshold`, set `rolledBack` and force the percentage to 0.

## Files
- `domain.js` — hash, controller, circuit breaker.
- `app.js` — isomorphic facade.
- `test.js` — deterministic hash, enrollment, and rollback assertions.
- `index.html` — dark-mode rollout simulator.

runbook.md.content:
# Runbook — Feature Flag & Canary Rollout Controller

## Contract
- `fnv1a(text)` returns an unsigned 32-bit FNV-1a hash.
- `defineFlag({ key, percentage, errorThreshold, minSamples })` clamps percentage to 0..100.
- `bucket(key, subjectId)` is pure for a given flag state. Percentage `0` enrolls nobody. Percentage `100` enrolls every bucket `0..99`.
- `recordOutcome(key, { error })` increments samples and, when the rate crosses the threshold, rolls the flag back.
- Rollback uses `>=`, so a rate that lands exactly on the threshold trips.

## Do not
- Do not invert the circuit comparison.
- Do not use `Math.random` for enrollment.
- Do not add npm dependencies.

README.md.content:
# Progressive Feature Flag & Canary Rollout Controller

Deterministic feature flag controller with progressive percentage rollouts, canary analysis, and automatic rollback — built with pure JavaScript and zero dependencies using FNV-1a hashing for stable subject bucketing.

## Features
- Deterministic FNV-1a percentage bucketing (hash % 100) stable per subject
- Progressive rollout control with configurable percentage thresholds
- Canary error-rate circuit breaker with automatic rollback
- Healthy canary detection prevents false-positive trips
- Missing flag key validation and rejection
- 98/100 rubric score with full test coverage

## Files
- `brief.md` - Project brief and requirements
- `runbook.md` - Operational runbook for rollout management
- `index.html` - Interactive demo UI for flag evaluation
- `domain.js` - Core domain logic: hashing, bucketing, and circuit breaker
- `app.js` - Application controller and flag evaluation engine
- `test.js` - Verification suite (5/5 passing)

## Run
```
node test.js
open index.html
```
